proofLimits: D01 compares one Python direct launch and one actual Foundation QMDProcessRunner launch on separate fresh owned indexes. K01/K02 are unrun; no app launch, macOS UI, private corpus, semantic model, inference or distribution is exercised.

Collection completion and successful child updates are separate observations. This diagnostic packet never accepts a keyword or lifecycle journey and cannot identify a signal sender or prove a Node cause.
The outer harness stdout/stderr are retained. The production QMDProcessRunner discards QMD stderr and bounds internal streams; this receipt does not contain those discarded originals.
Native Node/SQLite/vec admission is macOS ARM64-specific. Earlier Linux evidence is not substituted for actual Darwin loading.
PID/start/UID/group, file identities and hashes are boundary observations, not a continuous host-wide attestation. External runner termination can prevent teardown.

sourceExport.qualification: Only two Core files, four actual services and the new harness; copied permissions are owner-only, original Git modes remain recorded.
